subject: Reconcile audit coverage for backup replication / third-party responsibilities
messages:
From: Audits CloudVault <audits@cloudvault.io>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: Emily Ross <emily.ross@finserve.com>
Date: Sun, 2 Nov 2025 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Coverage clarification requested: backup replication & subservice dependencies

Hi Sean,

Thanks for the quick sync last week. Our audit team is preparing the SOC 2 Type II fieldwork packet for FinServe and we need to confirm a couple of items related to Redwood's use of CloudVault (our storage provider) and any carve-outs that would affect the effective coverage period. Specifically:

- For the audit period Oct 1, 2024 – Sep 30, 2025, does Redwood consider CloudVault a subservice organization in-scope (full inclusion) or are you relying on a carve-out (i.e., CloudVault's SOC report and a bridge letter)?
- If carve-out: can you confirm the exact responsibilities CloudVault retains vs. Redwood (encryption at rest, key management, backup replication scheduling, and incident notification SLAs)?
- Do you have a bridge letter or interim attestation that maps CloudVault's audit window to our fieldwork dates?

We'd appreciate a short statement and any supporting artifacts (bridge letter, CloudVault SOC summary) by Nov 6 to keep our timeline. Attachment: cloudvault-soc-summary.pdf (we also attached a template request form for vendors if helpful).

Best,
Laura (on behalf of Audits CloudVault)
Audits Team
CloudVault Compliance
[Attachment: cloudvault-soc-summary.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Audits CloudVault <audits@cloudvault.io>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Emily Ross <emily.ross@finserve.com>
Date: Mon, 3 Nov 2025 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Coverage clarification requested: backup replication & subservice dependencies

Hi Laura — thanks for the note and the summary. Short answers up-front: we are treating CloudVault as a third-party subservice that we rely on for object storage/replication, and we intend to provide CloudVault's SOC 2 Type II report + a Redwood cover memo (bridge statement) that explains shared responsibilities for the audit period.

A couple of clarifying asks from our side so we provide exactly what you need:
- Can you confirm whether you require a CloudVault bridge letter that explicitly ties CloudVault's SOC report period to the FinServe audit window, or will a Redwood attestation mapping CloudVault controls to our control activities suffice?
- Are you asking for the full subprocessor inventory (CSV) or only the items related to storage/replication?
- Any required format for the mapping table (e.g., CSV columns)?

We will pull CloudVault's SOC report and prepare a short cover memo that lists the split responsibilities (key management: Redwood; storage durability & replication scheduling: CloudVault; encryption-at-rest: CloudVault with customer keys managed by Redwood KMS). Expect initial package by Nov 6. Attaching our SOC request template so you can see the fields we will populate.

Thanks,
Sean Gallagher
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192
[Attachment: Redwood_SOC2_Request_Form.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Audits CloudVault <audits@cloudvault.io>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Emily Ross <emily.ross@finserve.com>
Date: Thu, 6 Nov 2025 08:24:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Coverage clarification requested: backup replication & subservice dependencies

Hi Laura / Audit team — forwarding the artifacts we gathered for FinServe.

Attached: CloudVault SOC summary (their customer-facing one-pager we obtained), our subprocessor inventory extract filtered to storage/replication, and a short Redwood cover memo that maps responsibilities for the Oct 1, 2024 – Sep 30, 2025 window. Highlights:
- CloudVault SOC report window: 2024-09-15 to 2025-09-14 (their Type II period). We will include a bridge statement that confirms no material changes in controls between 2025-09-15 and 2025-09-30 relevant to FinServe's scope.
- Responsibility split (summary):
  * CloudVault: physical security, storage replication, encryption-at-rest by default, incident detection at infrastructure layer.
  * Redwood: customer key management (KMS), application-layer encryption, access control, audit logging, data retention policies, and notification escalation to customers.
- We mark CloudVault as a carve-out that is supported by their SOC report + Redwood bridge memo. Red flags to watch for: any difference in CloudVault's tested controls vs. our actual implemented processes (we documented mapping in the attached CSV).

We also included a short mapping table (Drive link below) showing control IDs and where testing evidence will come from (CloudVault SOC vs Redwood logs). Let us know if you want a signed attestation or if internal cover memo is sufficient.

Thanks — Monica
Monica Patel
Security & Compliance Manager, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com | +1 (650) 555-0227
[Attachments: cloudvault-soc-summary.pdf (application/pdf), subprocessor-inventory-2025-10.csv (text/csv), Redwood_SOC2_Request_Form.pdf (application/pdf)]

> - Are you asking for the full subprocessor inventory (CSV) or only the items related to storage/replication?
> - Any required format for the mapping table (e.g., CSV columns)?

>

> Sean

From: Audits CloudVault <audits@cloudvault.io>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: Emily Ross <emily.ross@finserve.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 6 Nov 2025 15:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Coverage clarification requested: backup replication & subservice dependencies

Monica / Sean — thank you for the quick turnaround and the attachments. We reviewed the materials and the mapping table. A couple of final items before we close the scope:

1) For the audit evidence folder we will accept Redwood's cover memo (unsigned is OK) that states CloudVault performed the infrastructure/replication controls during the audit period and a copy of CloudVault's SOC 2 Type II report for 2024-09-15 to 2025-09-14.
2) Please include the specific control IDs from CloudVault's report that correspond to replication scheduling and encryption-at-rest in the mapping CSV (column: CloudVault_Control_ID).
3) We noted one minor gap in the mapping where CloudVault lists "incident response escalation (ops-to-customer)" as responsibility but your cover memo shows Redwood as the notifier. Please add a clarifying sentence on expected notification timelines and which party initiates customer outreach for incidents that affect FinServe.

If you can send a short addendum addressing (2) and (3) plus the CloudVault SOC PDF by EOD Nov 10 we can close our scoping and proceed to fieldwork scheduling.

Best,
Laura
Audits Team
CloudVault Compliance
[Inline: Reviewed mapping table]
